hints.title: Grid Reveal Rules
hints.text: Inspect clicked square. If an unrevealed mine is clicked, turn it into a revealed mine. Otherwise count neighboring mines in eight directions.

hints.title: Blank versus Numbered Cells
hints.text: If neighbor mine count is positive, update cell with that count digit and stop. If zero, mark cell as blank and recursively process all adjacent unrevealed squares.

hints.title: Eight-Directional Flood Fill
hints.text: Clicking an unrevealed mine immediately turns it to X. If an empty cell has zero neighboring mines, mark it as B and trigger the reveal on all eight adjacent cells that remain unrevealed. Stop the expansion whenever a cell has at least one neighboring mine.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear traversal touching each cell at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to stop recursion at numbered cells reveals areas that should remain hidden.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place grid updates avoid auxiliary visited allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly distinguish revealing an unrevealed mine versus expanding blank areas across all 8 neighbor directions.
